@graph.description: Does a small business in Pakistan need a website, or are Facebook and Instagram enough? A practical guide to choosing based on how customers find you.

mainEntity.name: Is a Facebook page enough?

acceptedAnswer.text: For some very small, walk-in businesses it may be enough to begin with. If customers search Google or want to compare, a website helps.

mainEntity.name: Are free website builders okay?

acceptedAnswer.text: They can work for a basic start, but check the domain, ads, design limits and whether you can move your content later.

mainEntity.name: How much does a website cost?

mainEntity.name: Is creating a Google Business Profile free?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, creating and managing a profile is free.

mainEntity.name: Can I list a business that has no shop?

acceptedAnswer.text: Often yes, as a service-area business, if you meet Google guidelines. You may hide the address.

mainEntity.name: Why was my profile suspended?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common causes are keyword-stuffed names, fake addresses, duplicate listings or policy violations. Check Google guidance before appealing.

mainEntity.name: Should I also have a website?

acceptedAnswer.text: It helps. A website gives Google and customers more detail about you. See our website development service.
